description: Erection of a two storey side extension following demolition of the garage and elevational alterations to the ground floor rear extension and front boundary wall.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 00, 01, 02, 03, 05, Fire safety strategy received 04/03/2024, 11 Rev B, 12 Rev B, 13 Rev B, 15 Rev B, Design and Access Statement received 26/04/2024.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - The zinc roof colour of hereby approved extension should match the colour of the existing roof.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular access to shall be permanently closed and kerbs/verge/footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.

Condition : 6 - The dwelling house, as enlarged in accordance with this permission, shall only be used as a single unit of accommodation, and shall not be subdivided, separated or altered in any way so as to create two or more separate units of accommodation, without further grant of planning permission.
